candidate.selection_reason: Default html:false configuration -> if changed to true by admin -> allows raw HTML in markdown rendering

candidate.sink_summary: Parser configuration flows to Remarkable markdown parser which renders user content via markdownify hook
candidate.guard_summary: Default configuration sets html:false; admin can change via settings but requires admin privileges
